description: FREE index declaration: record the tenant's domains (<= 50) and queue the per-tenant index build (sitemap + Common Crawl CDX discovery over these domains only; pages fetched from these domains only). Tenant submits domains -> index builds -> search tolls $0.01. — no payment required: call directly without payment (no x402 challenge; this tool is free). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/cse/index/declare.

domains.description: The tenant's own domains (hostnames; URLs are normalised to hosts).

tenant_id.description: Tenant identity: the payer wallet / key identity.

name: cse_declare_index
